The hanger is made in plastic, which can be easily removed and discarded, to avoid being forgotten and ending up as a plastic wastechange! 
The hanger makes fantastic light decorations, but we think it´s equally lovely uplit with fairy lights – what do you think? It comes in two versions:
The first version allows the hanger to be hung up from the ceiling – perfect as it hangs beautifully over trees, which means that it will catch some light and allow you to see exactly where your fairy lights are situated!
